children: LTC Properties reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $115.2 million and net income available to common stockholders of $346.4 million, compared with a net loss in the year-earlier quarter. Diluted earnings were $6.39 per share, while diluted Core FFO was $0.71 per share. The results included substantial gains on real estate sales as the company continued expanding its seniors housing operating portfolio.
Financial Highlights
Revenue:
$115.2 million, up from $69.3 million in third-quarter 2025.
Net income available to common stockholders:
$346.4 million, compared with a loss of $20.1 million a year earlier. Net income included a $323.9 million gain on real estate sales.
Diluted earnings per share:
$6.39, compared with a loss of $0.44 per share in the prior-year quarter.
Adjusted diluted FFO per share:
Core FFO was $0.71 per diluted share, up from $0.69 a year earlier.
2026 guidance:
LTC reaffirmed diluted Core FFO guidance of $2.76 to $2.78 per share and raised its SHOP investment midpoint target to $1 billion.
Business Highlights
LTC’s SHOP portfolio had grown to 50 communities managed by 14 operators, including 12 new company relationships, since the platform launched in May 2025.
Through October, SHOP acquisitions reached nearly $950 million, exceeding the company’s previously disclosed midpoint target for 2026.
Third-quarter transactions included 12 SHOP communities with 1,218 units acquired, and sales of 17 skilled nursing centers and 17 seniors housing communities.
Fourth-quarter acquisitions disclosed to date included four communities with 512 independent living, assisted living and memory care units.
The company narrowed its 2026 SHOP NOI guidance to $73.5 million to $76.4 million and reported third-quarter SHOP NOI of $19.7 million, compared with $4.8 million a year earlier.
